settings.heading: Functional Tea Blends
settings.intro:
VIBBO makes functional tea blends from whole, traceable ingredients grown in Guatemala — never powders, never "natural flavors", never added sugar. Each blend is built around a purpose: energy, digestion, or rest.

A functional tea is one where the ingredients are chosen for what they do, not only for how they taste. Ours are loose-leaf and biodegradable tea bags, blended in small batches, with every ingredient printed on the tin.

settings.title: Energy & Hydration
settings.text: A black tea blend with cocoa husk, coconut, dried black lemon, hibiscus, pineapple and raisins. Caffeine that lifts without the crash, built for mornings and long afternoons.

settings.title: Detox & Digestion
settings.text: Fennel, mint, ginger, coriander, boldo and pineapple. An earthy, refreshing herbal blend made to drink after meals.

settings.title: Calm & Rest
settings.text: Rosemary, lavender, passionflower, lemon verbena, orange peel, ginger and cinnamon. Caffeine-free and aromatic, for slowing down at the end of the day.

settings.title: Traceable from the source
settings.text: We buy directly from Guatemalan growers and print where each ingredient comes from. Traceability is what separates a functional tea blend from flavored tea dust.

settings.section_desc: Three blends, three purposes. Whole ingredients, traceable to the Guatemalan farms that grow them.

settings.question: What is a functional tea blend?
settings.answer: A functional tea blend is a tea whose ingredients are chosen for a specific effect — energy, digestion, or rest — rather than flavor alone. VIBBO blends use whole botanicals such as hibiscus, fennel, ginger and passionflower, with no added sugar, no sweeteners and no artificial flavoring.

settings.question: How are functional teas different from regular tea?
settings.answer: Regular tea is usually a single leaf picked for taste. A functional blend combines that leaf with botanicals that support a purpose, in quantities that actually matter. Ours are blended in small batches and every ingredient is listed on the tin.

settings.question: Do your functional tea blends contain caffeine?
settings.answer: Energy & Hydration is built on a black tea base, so it does contain caffeine. Detox and Calm are herbal blends and are caffeine-free.

settings.question: When should I drink each blend?
settings.answer: Energy & Hydration in the morning or early afternoon. Detox after meals. Calm in the evening, since it is caffeine-free.

settings.question: Where are your ingredients grown?
settings.answer: In Guatemala, bought directly from growers we work with. We print the origin of each ingredient so you can trace what is in your cup.
